gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-thai-loop: Azonix draws wide-mouthed capitals that barely rise above its lowercase, every stroke squeezed out in one steady line like toothpaste. Noto Sans Thai Looped, tall-bodied and sans-serif, would swamp it if the heading shrank.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Noto Sans Tifinagh reads soft and inviting, its rounded lowercase bowls filling the line like inflated shapes. Azonix, though, bends its curves with rope-like heft, so words take a moment to knit together.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Azonix holds one monoweight stroke from start to finish, with capitals only just taller than its lowercase. Noto Sans Tirhuta then brings a dominant x-height and terminals cut back to leave generous gaps.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Noto Sans Ugaritic reads friendly and plain, its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and its mouths left open like unjoined chalk arcs. And Azonix, with its pressure-free ballpoint line, supplies the commanding weight up top.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-vai: Round-pen letters, wide and confident. Noto Sans Vai lays words down as solid blocks instead of skylines, with generous space where curves meet stems, while Azonix stays crisp and commanding above it.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Noto Sans Vithkuqi reads clean and modern, with open throats on its a, c, e and s and barely any step up to capitals. Make Azonix small and its single-weight rounds still hold.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Azonix keeps its bowls free of any swelling, every wide-mouthed letter drawn with the same authority. Noto Sans Wancho, a plain sans, packs a hulking lowercase like pressed chalk, so paragraphs feel dense yet its gapped e keeps them breathing.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-warang-ci: Azonix is all commanding wide letters with no swelling mid-curve, and capitals that sit only slightly above the lowercase. But Noto Sans Warang Citi sets words as solid blocks, with wide channels into each counter, so extended text moves smoothly.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-yi: Authoritative from the first letter, Azonix is drawn with a compass-pencil consistency and wide, crisp mouths. Noto Sans Yi does the quieter work, with a deep midsection and unlatched rounds.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar: Azonix has a plain, unmodulated outline and wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp even when shrunk. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square follows with a soaring x-height and wide gaps, giving the heading's command a friendly, approachable partner below.
